fails_if: the SCB records reader compares a raw label (its padding, non-breaking space or doubled space) instead of the cleaned one, keeps a width's sign or leading zeros or reads a decimal width as an integer, flattens a description's line breaks, indentation or column alignment, folds two descriptions that differ in text, or drops a raw cell from a field or from the record's identity
note: The replaced test spelled Å as A plus a combining ring (U+030A), which no cp1252 SCB export can deliver; the precomposed Å is the deliverable form. Folding the combining form is `test_normalization.py::test_labels_fold_whitespace_and_unicode_without_folding_spelling`. The clean values are the raw cells without padding, with every run of spaces one space; a description keeps its line structure with its line ends as LF and each line's trailing space dropped.
